title: rubus triphyllus subsp. adenochlamys
intro: Rubus triphyllus subsp. adenochlamys, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a subspecies of raspberry native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rubus triphyllus subsp. adenochlamys include analgesic and anti-arthritic effects, as well as the potential to support cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
